snippet.title: A cozy puzzle adventure with George the Mischievous Horse - Back to Stables Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet George the Mischievous Horse. George loves a good adventure, but this time, he's wandered too far. Can you help him find his way back home?

Back to Stables is a cozy puzzle game where you guide George back to his trailer using delicious apples to lure him while avoiding the scary forest creatures. Enjoy the relaxed atmosphere and charming environments, all while unlocking customization options for George to arrive home in style.

Back to Stables is releasing in March on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4362830/Back_To_Stables/
